item.title: Tom Green County Civil Suit Alleges 13 Years of Childhood Sexual Abuse
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A civil lawsuit alleging more than a decade of sexual abuse of a child continues in the 119th District Court of Tom Green County. The suit, filed Feb. 6, 2025, states the victim was sexually assaulted from the time she was 4 years old until she was 17. Learn More Here.

item.title: Robert Lee Fisherman Catches Most Recent ShareLunker at Lake Ivie
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Robert Lee’s Brandon Soliz caught an 11.88-pound bass on Feb. 4 at O.H. Ivie Reservoir, marking the fifth ShareLunker that has been pulled from the lake in 2026.While Ivie, located about 55 miles east of San Angelo, has led the state in producing ShareLunkers in recent years, a new frontrunner has emerged this year — Lake J.B. Thomas. Learn More Here.

item.title: Sex Offender Arrested After Fleeing to Brown County
item.description: EARLY, TX — A registered sex offender from Kermit was arrested Saturday, Feb. 7, in Brown County.Arron Boner, 23, was arrested in Brownwood after a tip was received from Crime Stoppers. Boner, who left from Kermit, was reported to be on the run from law enforcement according to the Kermit Police Department.A warrant was issued for Boner after he failed to register as a sex offender.Maggen Blankenship was also arrested with Boner and was charged with obstruction. Learn More Here.

item.title: WATCH: No. 2 Angelo State Rambelles Head to Florida
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The Angelo State softball team travels to Florida this weekend for a five-game road trip across three days, beginning Friday.The Rambelles will face Embry-Riddle on Friday, play a doubleheader against Florida Tech on Saturday and conclude the trip with two games Sunday against Rollins. Learn More Here.

item.title: Abilene Woman, Child Killed in Crash Near Eula
item.description: EULA, TX — A 36-year-old Abilene woman and an 11-year-old child were killed in a two-vehicle crash Wednesday outside the small town of Eula.According to the Texas Department of Public Safety, the car carrying the two victims was headed south on FM 603 when the driver disregarded a stop sign at the intersection of State Highway 36. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State's Zoey Sifuentes Named LSC Freshman of the Week
item.description: RICHARDSON, TX — Angelo State third baseman Zoey Sifuentes has been named the Lone Star Conference Freshman of the Week after a standout performance at the George and Ola McCorkle Challenge presented by West Texas Steel.Sifuentes hit .500 with three doubles and three RBIs as the Rambelles went 4-1 during the weekend tournament at Mayer Softball Field in San Angelo.
